title: Remove hero section image from homepage

requirements.text: Remove the image element located at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/img[1] from the Hero component
acceptanceCriteria: The image element at the specified XPath is no longer rendered in the Hero component
The Hero component layout adjusts gracefully without the removed image
No broken image references or console errors occur

constraints: Only remove the image from the Hero component, do not delete the actual image file from the project
Preserve all other Hero component functionality and content
nonGoals: Deleting the image file from the project assets
Removing images from other pages or components
Changing the Hero component's overall layout or styling beyond accommodating the removed image
